exposure: Suture fixation of the levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine device (LNG-IUD) by hysteroscope
cohort: Twenty-one patients with large symptomatic adenomyosis at high risk of device expulsion were included.
finding: Suture fixation of the LNG-IUD by hysteroscope is a safe, effective, and minimally invasive surgical procedure that prevents device expulsion and effectively manages symptoms related to large symptomatic adenomyosis.
